properties.text: On December 19th, 2025, autonomous people of conscience gathered outside the New York Times Building to host a vigil and raise awareness about / mobilize the community against genocide in Gaza. Here is a message from Mahmoud in Gaza. Watch as passersby are forced and happy to sympathize with Palestinian suffering and support those speaking up for oppressed people in this world. Kindness still exists. Don’t let the Zionists win.
